description:
Transform diaper duty into a pleasure with the 6-Drawer Changing Table from Fisher Quality Products. This versatile piece combines the convenience of a dedicated changing station with the generous storage of a six-drawer dresser, making it the ultimate nursery workhorse.
Crafted from solid hardwoods and available in a rich Brown Maple finish, this changing table is built to last through multiple children and beyond the diaper years. The spacious flat top accommodates a standard changing pad, giving you a safe, comfortable surface for daily care. Below, six smooth-gliding drawers with sturdy construction provide organized storage for onesies, sleepers, blankets, diapers, wipes, and everything else your little one needs.
The timeless design fits seamlessly into any nursery decor, from traditional to transitional. Once the changing years are behind you, simply remove the pad and enjoy a beautiful six-drawer dresser that grows with your child into the teenage years. All finishes are non-toxic and baby-safe, meeting the highest safety standards.
